2607.11621.title: Lesioned Multimodal Language Models Reproduce Aphasic Picture-Naming Patterns
2607.11621.paper_summary: Aphasia following stroke commonly produces systematic naming errors with characteristic profiles, but whether general-purpose language models not designed for clinical simulation can reproduce these patterns remains untested. We investigated (1) whether lesions or controlled perturbations to a multimodal language model can reproduce different types of errors in picture naming, and (2) whether the framework can reproduce the complete error profile of individual persons with aphasia (PWAs). Using LLaVA 1.6, we evaluated perturbation configurations that varied the layer, proportion, and amount of noise applied to model units. We examined 278 PWAs on the Philadelphia Naming Test, classifying responses into seven categories using a validated neural classifier. Six of seven response categories (correct, semantic, mixed, unrelated, neologism, no response errors) emerged at clinically-comparable proportions across distinct parameter space regions, with formal paraphasia being the exception. Searching the perturbation space revealed configurations that reproduced the individual error profile in at least six of seven categories for 97.8% of PWAs and in all seven categories for 79.5% of PWAs. Monte Carlo baselines confirmed that this matching reflects joint inter-category structure rather than marginal overlap. These results establish a quantitative framework for reproducing individual aphasic error patterns in picture naming. They suggest the potential for language models to serve as digital twins of individuals with post-stroke aphasia.
2607.11621.paper_summary_zh: 中風後的失語症通常會產生系統性的命名錯誤，並具有特徵性輪廓，但未經設計用於臨床模擬的一般性語言模型是否能重現這些模式尚未經過測試。我們調查了 (1) 病變或對多模態語言模型的控制擾動是否能重現不同類型的圖片命名錯誤，以及 (2) 該框架是否能重現個別失語症患者 (PWAs) 的完整錯誤輪廓。使用 LLaVA 1.6，我們評估了擾動配置，這些配置改變了應用於模型單元的層次、比例和噪聲量。我們對 278 名 PWAs 進行了費城命名測試，並使用經驗證的神經分類器將反應分類為七個類別。在不同參數空間區域中，七個反應類別中的六個（正確、語義、混合、無關、新造詞、無反應錯誤）以臨床可比的比例出現，正式的語音錯誤則是例外。搜尋擾動空間顯示出配置，能在 97.8% 的 PWAs 中重現至少六個類別的個別錯誤輪廓，並在 79.5% 的 PWAs 中重現所有七個類別。蒙特卡羅基準確認這種匹配反映了類別間的聯合結構，而非邊際重疊。這些結果建立了一個定量框架，用於重現圖片命名中個別失語症的錯誤模式。它們暗示語言模型有潛力作為中風後失語症患者的數位雙胞胎。
